recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, front-facing male portrait rendered through heavy impasto and palette knife techniques, where the subject's features are partially obscured by thick, horizontal strokes of vibrant yellow paint. The face emerges from the texture in muted grey and ochre tones, creating a weathered, sculptural effect against a solid, textured yellow background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background integration through shared horizontal brushwork
Contrast between the vibrant yellow field and the desaturated grey facial tones
Relationship between the thick, physical impasto texture and the underlying anatomical structure
Balance between the centered head and the small, dark horizontal mark in the lower right
coreInvariants: Heavy horizontal palette knife texture across the entire surface
A single dark, charcoal-like horizontal stroke in the bottom right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The head is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height, scaled to feel intimate yet monumental.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, though obscured, serve as the primary anchor, supported by the dark horizontal mark in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the horizontal texture across the background, settles on the central face, and then drops to the dark accent in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The surrounding yellow field acts as active negative space, carrying the same heavy texture as the subject to minimize separation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool Grey and Muted Ochre (Facial shadows and mid-tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Umber/Black (Bottom right mark and subtle facial crevices)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background vs. low saturation in the subject; consistent mid-to-high value across the canvas.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-texture oil painting background using a palette knife with horizontal strokes in vibrant yellow. In the center, paint a male face using muted greys and ochres, blending the edges into the yellow background with thick impasto layers. Ensure the facial features are visible but distressed.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single, thick, dark brown horizontal charcoal or oil pastel stroke in the bottom right corner, approximately 1/10th the width of the canvas.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistently horizontal across the entire image?
Is the yellow vibrant and dominant?
Is the face partially obscured by the paint texture?
Is there a dark horizontal mark in the bottom right?

postGenerationChecks: The image must look like a physical painting with 3D texture.
The face must appear to be 'under' or 'within' the yellow paint layers.
The horizontal scraping effect must be prominent.
The dark mark in the corner must be present and distinct.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a heavy horizontal palette knife texture in [Color A] over a centered portrait rendered in [Color B] and [Color C], ensuring the subject is integrated into the background texture, finished with a single dark horizontal stroke in the lower right.
